title: FCC greenlights rule allowing prisons to jam cellphone signals
summary: The Federal Communications Commission voted unanimously to allow state and local prisons to jam cellphones. In an announcement on Thursday, the FCC argues the rule will help combat an "influx of contraband cellphones" used to carry out crimes from prison. Jammers are generally banned under Section 3
author: Emma Roth
